title: Fixed Cutaway Hood and Y Flail Rotor Mower
description: One newly authored whole fixed tractor-mounted flail-mower-style implement in a deliberate rear-cutaway display. Two complete curved end cheeks and broad ground skids carry one long transverse rotor with twelve complete coarse blunt Y-shaped flail forms. A thick upper/front cylindrical hood has a deliberately open rear sector to expose the rotor rather than pretending to be an operating guard. A full separate grounded rear roller, two support arms, raised triangular attachment-style frame with three genuinely open eyes, upper gearbox-shaped case, exposed lateral shaft, forward input stub and closed outer side-drive cover complete the whole implement. No tractor, crop, detachable spare parts, engine, fuel tank or push handle. All geometry coordinates newly authored; no old mower or tiller geometry imported. Not the helical-strip push reel mower or walk-behind hooked-tine tiller resized. One model zero scenes. Static cutaway art only: no blade sharpness, hinged flail swing, mowing, rotation, transmission, input coupling fit, guard effectiveness, load, engineering, manufacture or safety capability made or verified. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
